'''The Billtops''' were a trio of three [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that performed as a musical band. Their repertoire was considered favorable by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> The Billtops provided entertainment at a party that was held in [[Popara's penthouse|the penthouse]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
